partition.policy: Twenty-eight answer-blind stable-hash members from each of the 15 official num_clauses strata.

adapterSemantics.projection: Each official signed-integer CNF clause becomes an or-formula over generic semantic atoms; all clauses become strict premises.
adapterSemantics.decision: A complete-context model is SAT only after direct validation against every source clause. A complete-context inconsistency is UNSAT only after the independent DPLL certificate verifier accepts it.
adapterSemantics.oracle: The satisfiable Boolean and source sat_reason or unsat_reason remain in a separate host-only object and are joined after the prediction exists.
adapterSemantics.sourceAnomalies: Nine records have a natural-language condition count different from num_clauses. They are retained and do not affect the official clauses projection.

claimBoundary: This is a comprehensive execution of the 420 development-visible members on the source-annotated formula track. The authors' official prediction prompt provides scenario, natural-language conditions, and question without the clauses annotation. This receipt is therefore not an official natural-language SATBench score, a leaderboard submission, or evidence of direct parsing of the generated puzzle prose.
